fortunes.text: Someone is grateful for you. It is not who you think.
A meal you share this season will taste better than the food itself.
You will receive a gift that costs nothing and means everything.
The light you bring to a room is noticed more than you know.
This year, the best gift you give will be your attention.
A tradition you thought was fading will surprise you by growing.
You will be asked for advice. Say what you actually think.
The cold outside is warming the people inside.
Someone is saving a seat for you at a table you don't know about yet.
This season's quiet moment will be the one you remember.
You will find what you lost in the last place you'd think to look. It's the first place, actually.
A child will say something that changes how you see an old problem.
The door you've been knocking on will open on the 25th. Bring patience.
You will be forgiven for something you've been carrying alone.
Someone is writing a letter to you right now. It won't be sent, but the writing will change them.
This is the year the tradition changes. Let it.
The person who seems most together tonight is the one who needs your help most.
You will be given an ending. It is actually a doorway.
The warmth you feel is not from the fire. It's from someone thinking of you across a distance.
A promise you made to yourself years ago is about to come true. You forgot it. That's why it worked.
The family you choose will save the family you were born into. Show up with both.
This season you'll understand why someone left. Forgive them before you do.
The best thing that happens to you this year will happen alone, on a quiet night, with no one watching.
You will out-give someone and they will never know. That's exactly what makes it count.
The peace you're looking for is on the other side of a conversation you've been avoiding since last December.
This is the Christmas that rewrites your family's story. Be the one who writes it.
You will survive the thing you think will break you, and the survival will teach you something the happiness never could.
The miracle isn't coming. You already performed it. Someone is alive because of a choice you made.
The music you hear tonight will follow you into spring.
You'll burn the cookies. They'll taste the best anyway.
Someone will take your photo tonight. It will be the one you keep.
A wish you made as a child is about to come true in a form you won't recognize.
You'll be asked to choose between being right and being together. Choose together.
The person sitting across from you tonight won't always be there. Look at them now.
The story you tell about this Christmas will be the one your family repeats for generations. Make it a good one.
